title: Exotic Vietnam with Ba Na and Hoi An
alt: The Golden Bridge held up by stone hands at Ba Na Hills
transport: A domestic flight, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.subtitle: Hanoi and Ninh Binh
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small boutique hotel in the old quarter

activities.name: Ninh Binh day tour
activities.description: South to Ninh Binh for a rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc and the limestone country around it.

activities.name: Cycle ride to Bich Dong pagoda
activities.description: A cycle ride through the rice fields to Bich Dong, a three tier pagoda built into the rock face.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights in the old quarter, with a full day south to Ninh Binh and a cycle ride to Bich Dong.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang and Ba Na Hills
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

activities.name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
activities.match: Ba Na Hills and Golden Bridge Day Tour
activities.description: The long cable car up to Ba Na, the Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands, and the French village and gardens at the top.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast for two nights near the beach, with a full day up at Ba Na Hills.

stops.name: Hoi An
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Garden hotel a short ride from the old town lanterns

program.name: Hoi An
program.description: A last night in the old trading town, with the afternoon free among the lanterns and tailors.

Check in at your hotel in the old quarter
Rest of the day free at your own pace

A rowing boat through the flooded caves at Tam Coc
A cycle ride through the rice fields

Board your cruise boat in the early afternoon
A night moored among the limestone islands
4: Breakfast on board, then the climb into the Surprise Cave
Back to the pier and on to Hanoi airport
Check in near the beach, evening free
5: Breakfast, then the cable car up to Ba Na
The Golden Bridge held up by two stone hands
The French village and the gardens at the top
Back down to Da Nang in the evening

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: North and centre rather than north and south. Ba Na Hills and Hoi An are the two the centre is known for.
expert.tip: Go up Ba Na early. The bridge is empty for the first hour and the cloud tends to clear before the crowds arrive.

summary: Seven days from Hanoi to the central coast: two nights in the old quarter with a Ninh Binh day and a Bich Dong cycle ride, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave, two nights in Da Nang for Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge, and a last night in Hoi An.
included: Included: 6 nights with breakfast and dinner at the hotels and all meals on the cruise boat; the domestic flight to Da Nang; private transfers throughout; a Ninh Binh day tour; a cycle ride to Bich Dong; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a full day up at Ba Na with the Golden Bridge.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
